Brian C. Newberry criticizes Rhode Island Democratic Party leadership in recent tweets
Brian C. Newberry, former House Minority Leader in Rhode Island, shared critical remarks about the state's Democratic Party leadership on October 13 and commented on national judicial politics on October 14.
Brian C. Newberry, a Rhode Island politician and former House Minority Leader, posted a series of tweets on October 13 and 14, 2026, addressing the state of the Rhode Island Democratic Party and broader political developments.
On October 13, Newberry criticized the current leadership of the Rhode Island Democratic Party, stating, "The Rhode Island Democratic Party has been taken over by these dangerous clowns to the point where the rich corporate CEO running as their candidate for Governor has to kiss the ring of the 27 year old communist new mayor of Providence. It's appalling."
The following day, Newberry commented on national judicial politics with a reference to a historical event: "It all goes back to Robert Bork and it is all absolutely ridiculous at this point." Later that same day, he posted another tweet referencing popular culture: "Captain Renault is shocked..."
Brian C. Newberry served as House Minority Leader in Rhode Island from 2011 to 2017 and remains an active figure in state politics. His reference to Robert Bork points to the contentious U.S. Supreme Court nomination process in 1987, which has had lasting effects on federal judicial confirmations.
